Where Watts found it
Watts printed the hymn under Ephesians 1:3. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms. EPHESIANS 1:3 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ EPHESIANS 1
